question: Spider webs are made up of ______, a natural fibre made up of protein.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Silk**__.

__
 
• **Spider webs are made up of silk a natural fiber made up of protein**__.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• **Spider web or cob web **is a structure made by a spider.

 
 
• It is made from proteinous spider silk extracted from its spinneret.
 
• The spider's web is usually there to catch its prey.
 
• The spinneret glands are located at the tip of the spider's abdomen.
 
• Each gland produces a thread for a specific purpose.
 
• Uses: Cobweb painting, Ranticles in telescopes, Cow horn resonators in xylophones.
